name: side-panel
description: A pane beside the transcript of the sessions you name: the open pull requests of your repositories, each new head with a Review button, and sections your own command prints (other sessions, CI minutes, what needs you).

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: A regular expression of the session titles that show the pane. Empty shows it in every session.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: The repositories whose open pull requests the pane lists, as owner/name separated by spaces. Empty lists none.

reviewed.title: Review comment
reviewed.description: A regular expression (case-insensitive) a pull request comment must match, beside naming the head's short SHA, for that head to count as reviewed (for example Verdict|Review). Empty counts any comment that names the head.

review_prompt.title: Review prompt
review_prompt.description: What Review sends to the session, once it is idle. {repo}, {number}, {sha} and {title} are filled in.
review_prompt.default: Review {repo}#{number} at head {sha} ({title}) and post the verdict on the pull request, naming the head.

sections.title: Sections command
sections.description: A command whose output the pane shows below the pull requests: a line starting with ## is a heading; a line starting with ● is shown red, ✓ green, ⠋ blue. Empty shows none.

every.title: Refresh (seconds)
every.description: How often the pane reads GitHub and the sections command.
